article.story: NEW HAVEN, Conn. -- — Isaac Celiscar's 17 points helped Yale defeat Dartmouth 83-68 on Friday night. Celiscar shot 6 of 9 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line for the Bulldogs (16-3, 5-1 Ivy League). Nick Townsend scored 16 points while finishing 7 of 11 from the floor and added 10 rebounds and seven assists. Trevor Mullin went 5 of 8 from the field (3 for 3 from 3-point range) to finish with 13 points. Jayden Williams led the way for the Big Green (9-10, 3-3) with 18 points and six rebounds. Brandon Mitchell-Day added 13 points and six rebounds for Dartmouth. Kareem Thomas also recorded 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
